description: /Maand van de voetganger - Wandelingen is a dataset listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Mobiliteitsbedrijf Gent. Oktober is de maand van de voetganger. Tijdens deze maand zetten we 4 wandelingen in de kijker die je kan doen binnen en buiten het centrum. In deze dataset kan je de 4 wandelingen terugvinden alsook de.gpx bestanden om de wandelingen zelf te kunnen doen. Coverage: Ghent. The portal files it under Mobiliteit. Its keywords are Wandelroute, MaandVanDeVoetganger. The portal shows 4 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
